title: Evolving the axes: localised versions of the classic (2026-10-24)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Lets now think about the way we evolve the axes.

And these will probably be localised versions of the classic.

1. Energy dirction:   Getting things done vs developing how we get things done. (The current battle)
2. Change vs stabilty:   Should we integrate new ideas or keep refining the what we are doing now
3. Focus or Zoom out:  Defining our own plan or integrating practice from outside
